building_terminal_rule: Do not buffer the destination building facade; reject any line contact with the destination building except a single contact at the frozen exit endpoint. All other mapped obstacles get the configured setback.
eligibility_rule: Positive walkability and connected same-level evidence required for an upgrade. An unknown grade can only enter a marked hypothesis query; a recorded explicit grade conflict or obstacle rejects that segment.
local_scope_rule: Bounded door-centered disk intersected with a strip spanning the projection onto the native footway and the registered exit, clipped to the park polygon, subtract mapped obstacles.
path_algorithm: Visibility graph on polygon ring vertices and exact query endpoints with whole-segment coverage and obstacle checks; shortest UTM length.
selection_rule: Use N2_MAIN; N3 one-factor sensitivity only, no post-hoc selection.
